morphology.pattern_note: ke-...-an 把形容词 hebat 名词化，表示其性质或程度。ke- 中的 e 为 /ə/，hebat 中的 é 为 /e/；词根末尾 t 接元音后在音节划分上归入 tan。

senses.zh_definition: 卓越；非凡的本领、实力、成就或令人赞叹的气势。
senses.en_definition: Exceptional ability, excellence, power or impressiveness.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal hebat, terutama sifat luar biasa dari segi kebolehan, kekuatan, mutu atau penampilan.
senses.nuances: 常用于赞扬，但本词是抽象名词；直接称赞某人时常说 Dia hebat。kehebatan seseorang 指这个人出众的本领或实力。[DBP 词义与用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=kehebatan)。

senses.zh_definition: 猛烈或惊人的程度；事物的强烈、可怕或过甚之处。
senses.en_definition: The extraordinary intensity, severity or overwhelming force of something.
senses.nuances: 并非一律褒义。修饰暴风雨、爆炸等时可表示惊人的威力；描述事件强度时，kedahsyatan 或 kekuatan 有时更直接。

collocations.en: the tremendous force of an explosion

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kejayaan itu membuktikan kehebatan pasukan negara dalam menghadapi persaingan antarabangsa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项成就证明了国家队应对国际竞争的非凡实力。
dual_scenarios.en: That achievement demonstrated the national team's prowess in international competition.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Baru nampak kehebatan dia bila tengok dia main depan-depan lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kehebatan dirinya benar-benar terserlah apabila kita melihatnya bermain secara langsung.
dual_scenarios.zh: 亲眼看他比赛，才知道他有多厉害。
dual_scenarios.en: You only realise how good he is when you watch him play in person.

messages.ms_standard: Kehebatan dirinya benar-benar terserlah apabila kita melihatnya bermain secara langsung.

messages.en: You only realise how good he is when you watch him play in person.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul! Aku dah tengok video dia, tapi kat gelanggang lagi hebat.
messages.ms_standard: Betul! Saya sudah menonton videonya, tetapi permainannya lebih hebat apabila disaksikan di gelanggang.
messages.zh: 真的！我看过他的视频，不过现场看更厉害。
messages.en: Exactly! I've seen his videos, but he's even better in person.

etymology.historical_story: Kehebatan is formed in Malay from hebat with the abstract-noun circumfix ke-...-an. A nineteenth-century Malay dictionary already identifies hebat as Arabic-derived and records meanings involving fear and awe. Modern Malay retains overwhelming intensity while also using the family enthusiastically for outstanding talent, achievement and impressive performance. [Historical dictionary](https://deriv.nls.uk/dcn23/7945/79454630.23.pdf), [DBP hebat entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=hebat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hebat 是「厉害」，ke-...-an 把它装进名词框：kehebatan 就是「厉害之处、非凡实力」；遇到灾害则想「惊人威力」。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称赞他人的 kehebatan 很自然；谈自己的 kehebatan 容易显得自夸。正式致谢时，可把成绩归于团队合作。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于体育、艺术、专业能力及宏伟事物。谈论灾难或暴力事件时，应明确是在描述威力，避免让语气听起来像是在赞赏破坏行为。
